name: synergy-engine
description: Unity-style game engine template for TypeScript, built on PlayCanvas. Clone it, build your game.

scripts.dev: VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- bun run scripts/dev.ts
scripts.build: VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- bun run scripts/build.ts
scripts.start: VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- bun run scripts/serve.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p cloudflare/tsconfig.json
scripts.screenshot: VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- bun run scripts/screenshot.ts
scripts.preview:local: bun run build && VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- wrangler dev
scripts.preview:deploy: bun run build && VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- wrangler preview
scripts.deploy: bun run build && VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- wrangler deploy
scripts.desktop:dev: VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- bun run scripts/build.ts --outdir desktop/dist && cd desktop && bun ../node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs dev
scripts.desktop:build: VARLOCK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 varlock run -- bun run scripts/build.ts --outdir desktop/dist && cd desktop && bun ../node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs build --env=stable
